lines.text: You met me by Modern Ancient City
With raw sugar on my breath
Stone Mountain at our iron back
Glowed like moons above the road
You laughed and took my hand
Through Five Pines in the sun
Like a song I couldn’t outrun
When the crowd started to roll
Say my name, I’m all in
Far out to the Eastern Camp
Red Scarf Bridge in neon light
Along the old West Earth Wall
Growing with China Zun so tall
I kept your pure lotus charm
My green spring and my city
Through South Gong and Drum Tower
Like a song I couldn’t outrun
When the crowd started to roll
Say my name, I’m all in
Say my name, I’m all in
